notes: Experimental simulated means; forecast accuracy has not been established.
Full-season means use current roles in 17 schedule games with neutral weather and conditional availability.
Weekly and ROS include only unstarted games. No future injury return dates are invented.
Kickers: 3 per field goal, 1 per extra point. D/ST: OB full-scoreboard scoring.
Unknown offensive roles remain unrated. Unassigned production stays outside named-player rankings.
